$comment: P69 (lane lm, at its merge step after lane cs's fold — D-C-LIBRARY-BUILTIN-REFUSES-A-SHIPPED-SOURCE-BODY): a LIBRARY builtin (`__builtin_snprintf`, `__builtin_sprintf`, `__builtin_printf`) called with no header binds to the function the platform's realization gives a bare prototype of the name — and on pe and Mach-O the printf family's body is DSS's own runtime (runtime/platform/src/stdio.c), so the builtin must reach that runtime unit, not refuse (S_LibraryBuiltinUnavailable, what the binder answered for a shipped-source row) and not the platform's printf.
